source: JSON Schema generated by the existing local codex-cli 0.163.0-alpha.10.2 binary; no model turn

compatibility.notificationEnvelopes: The six consumed notification parameter envelopes are unchanged.
changes: Turn adds optional nullable string rootTurnId, retained and checked for contradictions between start and completion.
MessagePhase adds partial_answer. It remains non-final; only explicit final_answer plus a consistent completed turn can be exported.
CodexErrorInfo uses anyOf and adds an open string/object variant. Structured errors are preserved verbatim; no error string is interpreted as success.
Other ThreadItem variants changed; the consumed agentMessage shape and explicit final_answer phase remain unchanged.

limitations: Only the named exact protocols are accepted; declared protocol and observed cliVersion must match.
This is a consumed-subset comparison, not a full protocol schema validator.
Schema and fixture evidence do not prove real model execution, authorization, source authenticity or actual role tool restrictions.
